FAIL with 550 hits is EXPECTED: hits concentrate in d-test fixtures (.sh = 330 hits) that intentionally embed 'AtilCalculator' / 'atilcan65' to assert cleanup works, backlog.json (.json = 157 hits) which IS this project so self-references are correct, and 12 .tmpl hits which are template source-of-truth (NEVER rendered). ac2_ac5_implications.ac2_equivalent_rows: AC2 SHA-drift detection requires reading ADR-0075 §B.1 (38 shared scripts) and comparing calc vs tmpl file content. audit-project-refs FAIL is NOT a direct SHA-drift signal — it's a placeholder-leak detector. AC2 must use `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path} --jq .sha` for byte-identity.
ac2_ac5_implications.ac3_divergent_rows: AC3 patch verification requires reading ADR-0075 §B.2 (9 forward-port candidates) and grep'ing template content for Sprint 33+34 patch patterns (RETRO-026/027/030/032/033/034).
